question: Should OpenClaw ship this first-party Wear OS v1 with a matching-signed paired watch allowed to read bounded session history and invoke send or abort through the phone-owned Gateway session?
rationale: Tests can verify envelope handling, but only a product/security owner can accept the new authenticated action surface and the coupled Play release contract.

options.title: Approve phone-proxy v1 after proof
options.body: Keep the bounded status/history/send/abort surface and require exact-head paired-device plus Play validation evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow to status-only
options.body: Ship only connectivity status first and defer transcript and mutation operations to a later security-reviewed change.

options.title: Pause first-party Wear
options.body: Do not add the bundled watch application until product ownership and release operations are explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve phone-proxy v1 after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded status/history/send/abort surface and require exact-head paired-device plus Play validation evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue and consolidated branch place the architecture, product scope, and Android release integration under this person's direction.
